name: Wim Crouwel
bio: Dutch graphic designer, type designer and typographer. He was one of the founders of Total Design and made grid-based layouts, wordmarks and the typeface New Alphabet.

milestones.event: Was one of the founders of the design studio Total Design in Amsterdam.
Designed the typeface New Alphabet, made of horizontal and vertical strokes only.
Designed the wordmark of the Dutch bank Rabobank.
